messages:
sam-oncall: Heads-up — saw ~0.8% TLS handshake failures to eu-west from this morning's rollout, correlated with egress retries and higher tail latencies. Opening thread to track follow-ups.

mira-sre: thanks. can you paste the sample traces?

sam-oncall: pasted a few in the incident doc, but here's a quick tail: ```
ERROR tls: handshake timeout; peer=10.2.4.17
proto=TLS1.3; route=eu-west->us-east; retries=3
```

leo-neteng: looking at LB logs now — I see repeated SYN retransmits to the cross-region egress gateway around 09:12-09:18. Could be a transient path MTU or PMTU blackhole.

dan-platform: fwiw the canary config for that rollout set max-inflight=40 and switched to sticky routing to avoid cross-region failover. might have exposed a slow egress link.

mira-sre: action: leo to triage network path and run targeted pings + tcpdump to the problematic gateways; due EOD Thu.

leo-neteng: ack. collecting pcap now, will drop in the incident doc and link to packet capture on s3.

ashley-pm: we need owners for rollout gating: if TLS failure rate >0.5% for 10m, rollback. who owns the gating rule?

dan-platform: that's under platform feature flags — I'll add an automated alert and a runbook hook. assigning to @dan-platform, ETA 48h.

ops-bot: INC-4729 created: "egress TLS handshake spike during eu-west canary" assigned to leo-neteng, mira-sre.

mira-sre: additional follow-up: add metric for cross-region handshake failure by route (region_src->region_dst) and surface in Console per-route dashboard. owner: mira-sre, PR target by next Tue.

leo-neteng: early findings: one upstream egress host was dropping MSS in SYN-ACKs causing fragmentation. patch candidate: set tcp_mtu_probing=1 on route gateway; will test on staging first.

sam-oncall: test plan looks good. please paste the exact sysctl command and the rollout steps.

leo-neteng: command: `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` rollout: stage on eu-west-staging -> eu-west-canary -> eu-west-prod, 5m observation windows.

mira-sre: risk assessment: low config change but affects kernel tcp stack. do canary for 30 minutes with alerts.

ashley-pm: timeline check — can we have staging test by tomorrow AM and prod by EOD Fri if all green?

d an-platform: typo in handle; dan-platform: yes, I'll wire the alert and automated rollback today; if leo has staging verification by tomorrow, we can target Fri EOD for prod.

leo-neteng: starting staging test now, will report back in this thread with pcap + synthetic traffic results.

ops-bot: Note: added ticket RDW-389 to track per-route metrics dashboard work (owner: mira-sre).

mira-sre: one more long-term: schedule a recurring postmortem cadence to check for cross-region retry patterns — recommend weekly for 4 weeks. assigning to mira-sre (lead) + platform (support).

sam-oncall: summarize action items: 1) leo — staging test + patch + pcap (EOD Thu). 2) dan-platform — alert and rollback automation (48h). 3) mira-sre — per-route metrics PR (next Tue) + recurring follow-ups. 4) ashley-pm — communicate schedule to oncall rotation. will update incident doc and close after prod stable for 24h.

leo-neteng: staging done: MSS issue confirmed, tcp_mtu_probing flips handshake success from 99.2%->99.98% in synthetic. uploading pcap: s3://redwood-logs/pcaps/1858901234-issue.pcap

mira-sre: nice. dan-platform, can you wire the alert to trigger a slack roll-forward/rollback playbook? include runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/egress-tls-failures

dan-platform: on it. will add runbook hook + playbook message template.

ashley-pm: thanks team. will set a calendar invite for Fri status check and update customers if needed. :thumbsup:

sam-oncall: closing loop here once prod stable 24h. keeping thread open for any regressions.
